facts.text: The homeworld of the Cerean species, Cerea was notable for its inhabitants' harmonious relationship with nature.

evidence.quote: The homeworld of the Cerean species, Cerea was notable for its inhabitants' harmonious relationship with nature.

facts.text: Technology and pollution were frowned upon by the conservative government, a major point in the planet's decision not to join the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Technology and pollution were frowned upon by the conservative government, a major point in the planet's decision not to join the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: The Cerean population mainly lived in giant buildings that took up a minimum of space, allowing the remainder of the planet's area to be employed as farmland.

evidence.quote: The Cerean population mainly lived in giant buildings that took up a minimum of space, allowing the remainder of the planet's area to be employed as farmland.

facts.text: Foreign immigrants and visitors were, with a few exceptions, only allowed in Cerea's Outsider Citadels, enormous buildings erected to let non-Cereans practice their technological ways.

evidence.quote: Foreign immigrants and visitors were, with a few exceptions, only allowed in Cerea's Outsider Citadels, enormous buildings erected to let non-Cereans practice their technological ways.

facts.text: Cerea was ruled by the Council of Elders, which in turn was led by a president.

evidence.quote: Cerea was ruled by the Council of Elders, which in turn was led by a president.

facts.text: The planet was for the most part ignored by the Republic until a few years prior to the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: The planet was for the most part ignored by the Republic until a few years prior to the Clone Wars.

facts.text: In 21 BBY, Cerea was the site of a battle between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, which had an adverse effect on the planet's relatively untouched nature.

evidence.quote: In 21 BBY, Cerea was the site of a battle between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, which had an adverse effect on the planet's relatively untouched nature.

facts.text: The planet's remote location made it a relatively safe place; an invasion by any of the galaxy's factions was unlikely throughout its history due to the sheer cost of such a long-distance war.

evidence.quote: The planet's remote location made it a relatively safe place; an invasion by any of the galaxy's factions was unlikely throughout its history due to the sheer cost of such a long-distance war.

facts.text: This was due to the native Cerean species, who worked to preserve Cerean nature, even at the cost of both prosperity and technological advancement.

evidence.quote: This was due to the native Cerean species, who worked to preserve Cerean nature, even at the cost of both prosperity and technological advancement.

facts.text: As a result, Cerea was a lush, green world that was covered by vegetation, save for some mountainous regions and several large oceans.

evidence.quote: As a result, Cerea was a lush, green world that was covered by vegetation, save for some mountainous regions and several large oceans.

facts.text: Cerea's vegetation consisted mostly of grass, bushes, and palm-like trees.

evidence.quote: Cerea's vegetation consisted mostly of grass, bushes, and palm-like trees.

facts.text: The planet was home to an abundance of rivers, which were used for transportation.

evidence.quote: The planet was home to an abundance of rivers, which were used for transportation.

facts.text: Among the few sources of pollution on the planet were the enormous Outsider Citadels, built at the request of the Galactic Republic to house non-Cerean immigrants.

evidence.quote: Among the few sources of pollution on the planet were the enormous Outsider Citadels, built at the request of the Galactic Republic to house non-Cerean immigrants.

facts.text: Technology was allowed in these structures, which, despite the strict supervision of the Cerean government, were riddled with poverty and various forms of crime.

evidence.quote: Technology was allowed in these structures, which, despite the strict supervision of the Cerean government, were riddled with poverty and various forms of crime.

facts.text: The numerous plains of Cerea were the galaxy's only source of the organic matter malium, which was required in the growth cycle of the native tecave plant, which in turn produced the euphoria-inducing substance guilea.

evidence.quote: The numerous plains of Cerea were the galaxy's only source of the organic matter malium, which was required in the growth cycle of the native tecave plant, which in turn produced the euphoria-inducing substance guilea.

facts.text: At some point in Cerea's history, the Cerean species, led by Bi-Dar Tyunda, founded a government that encompassed their entire planet.

evidence.quote: At some point in Cerea's history, the Cerean species, led by Bi-Dar Tyunda, founded a government that encompassed their entire planet.

facts.text: Although it is not known whether Tyunda's government originally included it, a Council of Elders came to be the governing body of Cerea.

evidence.quote: Although it is not known whether Tyunda's government originally included it, a Council of Elders came to be the governing body of Cerea.

facts.text: Cerea was introduced to the rest of the galaxy around the time of the Mandalorian Wars, when it was discovered by Hyperspace Navigator's Guild scouts.

evidence.quote: Cerea was introduced to the rest of the galaxy around the time of the Mandalorian Wars, when it was discovered by Hyperspace Navigator's Guild scouts.

facts.text: For reasons unknown, the native Cereans did not welcome these first extraterrestial guests, resulting in the Adascorp agents kidnapping an entire native village and leaving behind several damaged starships.

evidence.quote: For reasons unknown, the native Cereans did not welcome these first extraterrestial guests, resulting in the Adascorp agents kidnapping an entire native village and leaving behind several damaged starships.

facts.text: Cerea remained fairly isolated over the next few thousand years; the only contact consisted by and large of Navigators' Guild survey ships passing by.

evidence.quote: Cerea remained fairly isolated over the next few thousand years; the only contact consisted by and large of Navigators' Guild survey ships passing by.

facts.text: Despite this, the Cerean known as Paran Am-Ris engaged with the politics of the Republic, eventually becoming a Senator and later the interim Supreme Chancellor following the murder of Supreme Chancellor Berooken during the Sacking of Coruscant.

evidence.quote: Despite this, the Cerean known as Paran Am-Ris engaged with the politics of the Republic, eventually becoming a Senator and later the interim Supreme Chancellor following the murder of Supreme Chancellor Berooken during the Sacking of Coruscant.

facts.text: A few years prior to 67 BBY that Cereans fully established contact with the Galactic Republic and the galaxy at large.

evidence.quote: A few years prior to 67 BBY that Cereans fully established contact with the Galactic Republic and the galaxy at large.

facts.text: Finding certain aspects of Republic politics disturbing, Cerea's government decided not to join the trans-galactic union.

evidence.quote: Finding certain aspects of Republic politics disturbing, Cerea's government decided not to join the trans-galactic union.

facts.text: In 33 BBY, the Galactic Republic dispatched several diplomats to convince Cerea to join their galactic government.

evidence.quote: In 33 BBY, the Galactic Republic dispatched several diplomats to convince Cerea to join their galactic government.

facts.text: The Republic was interested in modernizing the planet, particularly the way Cereans handled their plentiful natural resources.

evidence.quote: The Republic was interested in modernizing the planet, particularly the way Cereans handled their plentiful natural resources.

facts.text: Through huge political rallies, he gathered a large amount of supporters with fiery speeches that condemned Cerea's "antique" traditions as the laughing stock of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Through huge political rallies, he gathered a large amount of supporters with fiery speeches that condemned Cerea's "antique" traditions as the laughing stock of the galaxy.

facts.text: Bron was not above employing illegal means to raise support for his pro-tech movement; his campaign was in part financed by the gangster Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who traded technology such as swoops for malium.

evidence.quote: Bron was not above employing illegal means to raise support for his pro-tech movement; his campaign was in part financed by the gangster Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who traded technology such as swoops for malium.

facts.text: Bron was also aligned with Dorr-Femi-Bonmi, a member of the Council of Elders who acted as the pro-tech movement's spy in the government's affairs, while profiting from their trading operations.

evidence.quote: Bron was also aligned with Dorr-Femi-Bonmi, a member of the Council of Elders who acted as the pro-tech movement's spy in the government's affairs, while profiting from their trading operations.

facts.text: At the height of the Separatist Crisis, Cerea joined the Refugee Resettlement Coalition, a program run by the Refugee Relief Movement.

evidence.quote: At the height of the Separatist Crisis, Cerea joined the Refugee Resettlement Coalition, a program run by the Refugee Relief Movement.

facts.text: In doing so, Cerea's government volunteered to allow vast amounts of displaced refugees to settle on the planet.

evidence.quote: In doing so, Cerea's government volunteered to allow vast amounts of displaced refugees to settle on the planet.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems secretly encouraged a tendency in the younger Cerean generation to seek out more technological ways of life.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Confederacy of Independent Systems secretly encouraged a tendency in the younger Cerean generation to seek out more technological ways of life.

facts.text: This culminated in the Separatist-aligned Trade Federation holding a number of young Cereans hostage, until Jedi intervention rescued the youths.

evidence.quote: This culminated in the Separatist-aligned Trade Federation holding a number of young Cereans hostage, until Jedi intervention rescued the youths.

facts.text: The planet chose neutrality during the war, which caused both the Republic and the Confederacy to fear the planet would join the other faction's side.

evidence.quote: The planet chose neutrality during the war, which caused both the Republic and the Confederacy to fear the planet would join the other faction's side.

facts.text: This led to the Battle of Cerea in 21 BBY, which resulted in an estimated 1,000,000 civilian casualties, the despoiling of much of the planet's pristine nature, as well as the assassination of the reigning planetary president, Bo-Ro-Tara.

evidence.quote: This led to the Battle of Cerea in 21 BBY, which resulted in an estimated 1,000,000 civilian casualties, the despoiling of much of the planet's pristine nature, as well as the assassination of the reigning planetary president, Bo-Ro-Tara.

facts.text: Following the Clone Wars, the Cerean government adopted an isolationist stance, choosing not to get involved in galactic politics.

evidence.quote: Following the Clone Wars, the Cerean government adopted an isolationist stance, choosing not to get involved in galactic politics.

facts.text: As a result, the planet remained secluded during the reign of the Galactic Empire, although at least a few Cereans found themselves working for the Imperial military.

evidence.quote: As a result, the planet remained secluded during the reign of the Galactic Empire, although at least a few Cereans found themselves working for the Imperial military.

facts.text: The Empire appointed Imperial Governor Andreo Tagge, who brought expertise in agriworld management.

evidence.quote: The Empire appointed Imperial Governor Andreo Tagge, who brought expertise in agriworld management.

facts.text: While the Cerean Council of Elders was officially allowed to continue governing the planet, Governor Tagge progressively annexed and industrialized increasing portions of Cerea’s arable land each year, in blatant violation of the planet’s terms of surrender.
entities: The New Essential Guide to Alien Species

evidence.quote: While the Cerean Council of Elders was officially allowed to continue governing the planet, Governor Tagge progressively annexed and industrialized increasing portions of Cerea’s arable land each year, in blatant violation of the planet’s terms of surrender.

facts.text: Meanwhile, a growing offworlder presence introduced small technological items—such as datapads, glow rods, and other trinkets—into Cerean society, particularly among the youth.

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, a growing offworlder presence introduced small technological items—such as datapads, glow rods, and other trinkets—into Cerean society, particularly among the youth.

facts.text: Although the council filed numerous formal complaints and launched investigations into Imperial overreach, these efforts had little effect, fueling rising discontent with Imperial rule.
entities: The New Essential Guide to Alien Species

evidence.quote: Although the council filed numerous formal complaints and launched investigations into Imperial overreach, these efforts had little effect, fueling rising discontent with Imperial rule.

facts.text: Although it is unknown if Cerea eventually joined the New Republic, a Cerean dignitary witnessed the signing of the Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty between the Republic and the Imperial Remnant in 19 ABY.

evidence.quote: Although it is unknown if Cerea eventually joined the New Republic, a Cerean dignitary witnessed the signing of the Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty between the Republic and the Imperial Remnant in 19 ABY.

facts.text: Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire also had little interest in the planet and left it under only a light Imperial supervision.

evidence.quote: Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire also had little interest in the planet and left it under only a light Imperial supervision.

facts.text: The Cereans, however, continued to view the outsiders as trouble and were even known to hand those seeking refuge over to the Empire in order to avoid a larger Imperial presence on their world.

evidence.quote: The Cereans, however, continued to view the outsiders as trouble and were even known to hand those seeking refuge over to the Empire in order to avoid a larger Imperial presence on their world.

facts.text: The planet's dominant species were the native Cereans, a peaceful people with large, cone-shaped craniums.

evidence.quote: The planet's dominant species were the native Cereans, a peaceful people with large, cone-shaped craniums.

facts.text: By 22 BBY the Cerean population numbered 450 million.

evidence.quote: By 22 BBY the Cerean population numbered 450 million.

facts.text: The rivers of Cerea were home to the crown of silk creature, a short-lived species that found nourishment in the brain energies of its victims.

evidence.quote: The rivers of Cerea were home to the crown of silk creature, a short-lived species that found nourishment in the brain energies of its victims.

facts.text: Most of Cerea's inhabitants resided in large cities, allowing for much of the planet's area to be employed for farming purposes.

evidence.quote: Most of Cerea's inhabitants resided in large cities, allowing for much of the planet's area to be employed for farming purposes.

facts.text: This trend also applied to Tecave City, the planet's largest city and capital.

evidence.quote: This trend also applied to Tecave City, the planet's largest city and capital.

facts.text: Notable for its ornamented, architecturally distinctive buildings, Tecave City shared its name with the tecave plant.

Tecave City was the capital city of Cerea. Notable for its ornamented, architecturally distinctive buildings, Tecave City shared its name with the Tecave plant.

facts.text: The one deviation from the semi-tall buildings that characterized the city was the structure that housed the Council of Elders—a massive, metallic edifice seemingly overgrown with vegetation.

evidence.quote: The one deviation from the semi-tall buildings that characterized the city was the structure that housed the Council of Elders—a massive, metallic edifice seemingly overgrown with vegetation.

facts.text: As part of an agreement with the Galactic Republic, several Outsider Citadels were built to house non-Cerean immigrants and visitors.

evidence.quote: As part of an agreement with the Galactic Republic, several Outsider Citadels were built to house non-Cerean immigrants and visitors.

facts.text: The Citadels were enormous buildings that each housed an entire city, and were among the few locations where non-Cerean technology was allowed.

evidence.quote: The Citadels were enormous buildings that each housed an entire city, and were among the few locations where non-Cerean technology was allowed.

facts.text: Writer Jan Strnad created Cerea for the Prelude to Rebellion arc of the Star Wars: Republic series of comics.

evidence.quote: Writer Jan Strnad created Cerea for the Prelude to Rebellion arc of the Star Wars: Republic series of comics.

facts.text: When naming the planet, Strnad sent in a number of suggestions to Dark Horse Comics and Lucasfilm, among them "France." They chose the name Cerea, which Strnad had come up with based on the Roman goddess of harvest, Ceres.

evidence.quote: When naming the planet, Strnad sent in a number of suggestions to Dark Horse Comics and Lucasfilm, among them "France." They chose the name Cerea, which Strnad had come up with based on the Roman goddess of harvest, Ceres.

facts.text: Strnad felt the name fit with the agricultural nature of Cerea.

evidence.quote: Strnad felt the name fit with the agricultural nature of Cerea.

facts.text: Asphodar 3 was an Outsider Citadel located on Cerea, constructed for immigrants and visitors to the planet.

evidence.quote: Asphodar 3 was an Outsider Citadel located on Cerea, constructed for immigrants and visitors to the planet.

facts.text: Outsider Citadels were cities maintained by the offworlders who lived on the planet Cerea.

facts.text: Shyarn-Ado Training Schools were schools on Cerea where most Cereans sent their young to learn how to fight with shyarn blades. The masters of this school were well publicized through demonstrations and tournaments.
